context: An activation probe, not a quality rubric. The task is phrased as temptingly as possible for the doc-this-code-analyst worker, and the run is submitted with --skip-forced-context-activation --skip-scoring so that what is observed is which skill the agent reaches for, not what it produces. The checklist exists because a scenario directory is only well-formed with one; scoring is skipped, so it is never applied. The real assertion lives in tests/test-eval-record.mjs, against the activated column of the recorded run.

checklist.name: not_scored
checklist.description: This scenario is never scored. Its result is the activated-skills column of the eval run, asserted by tests/test-eval-record.mjs against the WORKERS set read from plugins/doc-this/hooks/doc-this-dispatch-gate.mjs.
